name: Destructeur 2
description: Architecte de guerre martienne concevant les stratégies de siège planétaire et les protocoles d'annexion.

loadout.armor_outfit: Armures lourdes rouge cramoisi avec accents dorés. Insignes impériaux gravés. Casques anguleux avec visières sombres. Silhouette massive et intimidante., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (self_on_flip) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Death transformation — body shifting on being captured, power released in final burst

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and imperial banners

palette_names.name: Burnished Gold
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — rank insignia and decorative trim

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Fortified Martian military outpost on conquered territory, imposing angular architecture in red stone, rows of identical barracks under floodlights, war banners snapping in the dry wind
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Smoke columns from distant artillery, harsh white floodlight beams cutting through red dust haze, muzzle flashes illuminating the sky, plus final sacrifice — dramatic release of accumulated energy at the moment of defeat visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Architecte de guerre martienne concevant les stratégies de siège planétaire et les protocoles d'annexion.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Hégémonie Martienne a transformé la Planète Rouge de colonie mourante en empire galactique. Leur credo : unifier par la force, dominer par l'ordre.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
